welcome_message:
🫡 **DropBot at your service**

Send me a file and I will download it to your server in the corresponding folder.

Send me a link (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, etc.) to download the video or audio.

⚙️ Use /settings to change how it behaves.
startup_not_persistent: ⚠️ **Settings will not be kept.** `/config` is not mounted as a volume, so whatever you change in /settings will be lost when the container is recreated. Add `- /your/path:/config` to the volumes of the docker-compose.
startup_settings_imported: ⚙️ Your docker-compose variables have been imported into /settings. From now on they are changed there, and you can remove them from the compose: only the Telegram ones are needed.
settings_unreadable: ⚠️ `$1` could not be read, so the defaults are in use and nothing will be saved until you fix it and restart the container.
settings_not_persistent: ⚠️ `/config` is not mounted as a volume: these settings will be lost when the container is recreated.
settings_lang_help: The language of the bot's messages and command menu.
settings_fmt_help: What to do when you send the bot a YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or similar link: ask whether you want the video or the audio, or always download it one way.
settings_send_help: What to do with the video or audio just downloaded from a link, whole playlists included. It does not affect the files you send to the bot from Telegram. Anything over 2 GB does not fit in Telegram and stays on the server only.
settings_par_help: How many files are transferred at once between Telegram and the server. The rest wait their turn.
settings_fast_help: How many parallel connections are opened for each large file, so it uploads and downloads faster. 1 uses Telegram's standard method. Between 4 and 8 usually works well.
settings_video_help: Only what Telegram cannot play is converted. If the hardware encoder fails, it is retried on the CPU automatically.
settings_hw_help: What videos are converted with. Hardware encoding needs access to the GPU in the docker-compose: `/dev/dri` for VAAPI and QSV, or NVIDIA Container Toolkit for NVENC. QSV is experimental: it needs Intel's runtime, which is not in the image.
settings_q_help: Higher values lower quality and size; lower values do the opposite. 23 is a good starting point. By default each encoder's own value is used.
settings_folders_help: Where each type of file goes. This is not changed here: it depends on which folders you mount in the docker-compose.
settings_folders_how: To send a type somewhere else, mount its folder as a volume (for example `- /path/videos:/video`) and recreate the container. The available ones are `/video`, `/audio`, `/photo`, `/torrent`, `/ebook`, `/url_video` and `/url_audio`.
settings_telemetry_help:
Once a day the bot sends anonymous figures to know how many people use it and which features are used most: the version, which settings you use and how many times each thing was used. Never file names, links, paths or Telegram IDs.

The statistics are public and belong to everyone: [you can see them here](https://stats.dgongut.com/dropbot), along with [exactly what is collected](https://stats.dgongut.com/dropbot/privacy).
settings_telemetry_forced_volume: 🔒 Off: `/config` is not mounted as a volume, and without it every recreation of the container would count as a new installation.
settings_telemetry_forced_env: 🔒 Turned off with the `$1` variable in the docker-compose.
telemetry_preview:
👀 **This is what would be sent now**
The identifier is created on the first send. [What each field means](https://stats.dgongut.com/dropbot/privacy).
settings_urlq_help:
The quality and format of what is downloaded from a link.

**Prefer Telegram-compatible** asks for H.264 video and AAC audio, which Telegram plays as they are: the video is sent in seconds instead of being converted. Since YouTube has no H.264 above 1080p, with this on a 4K video is downloaded in 1080p.

**Tags and cover** puts the title, the artist and the video thumbnail as cover art into the audio.
settings_vq_help: The best quality that does not go over this limit is downloaded. It counts the short side of the video, so a 1080×1920 vertical video is 1080p. If a video has nothing below it, the smallest one available is downloaded.
settings_aq_help: The quality of the MP3 taken from a link. More quality, bigger files. It cannot go above the original: if the video's audio is 128 kbps, raising it only makes the file bigger.
settings_links_help: How what you send the bot as a link (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok...) is downloaded. It does not affect the files you send it from Telegram.
settings_row_tags: Tags and cover in the audio
settings_af_help: **MP3** plays anywhere, but it has to be re-encoded and loses some quality. **M4A** keeps the AAC audio as it comes, without re-encoding: it sounds like the original, is smaller and takes less time.
settings_pl_help: What to do when the link is a playlist, and how many videos to download at most when getting all of it.
settings_plm_help: Ask whether you want all of it or only the first video, or always do the same.
settings_pll_help: When downloading a whole playlist, at most this many videos are downloaded, starting from the first. It keeps a link to a list of hundreds of videos from filling your disk.
settings_sb_help:
Removes from YouTube videos the segments the SponsorBlock community has marked. It only affects YouTube, and only videos with marked segments.

**Everything that is not content** also removes intros, outros, previews, filler and, in music videos, whatever is not music.
settings_max_help: Anything bigger than this is not downloaded. In a playlist that video is skipped and the rest carry on.
settings_ext_help: What to do with the compressed file after extracting it from /manage. If it is a multi-part RAR, all parts are deleted.
error_url_too_large: 📦 **Not downloaded:** it is over the maximum size of $1. You can change it in /settings → Links.
